pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual patches on the flank and lower neck exhibit irregular, jagged polygonal shapes with high-contrast, sharp edge gradients. The spatial area of patches is heterogeneous, with larger, more complex geometries located on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a complex topological graph. Junction nodes primarily feature three-way intersections. Pixel thickness of the pathways is variable across the visible surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck presents a distinct 1D jagged silhouette against the background, characterized by a high frequency of low-amplitude vertical protrusions.
